pr_title: Consistently serialize child members returned from route handlers
pr_comments: This change doesn't feel right to me but I understand the current inconsistency with the IResult type.

issue_context.title: Async minimal route handlers don't serialize child members

review_comments:
I added the following comment:

```C#
// Call WriteAsJsonAsync<object?>() to serialize the runtime return type rather than the declared return type.
```

I'm continuing to call `WriteAsJsonAsync<object?>(value)` because the alternative would be more like `WriteAsJsonAsync(value, value?.GetType() ?? typeof(object))`.
